mentions.name: Pensive
mentions.description: This is a bookmarking app built as a successor to Pocket, offering a search-first experience, integrations with tools like Telegram, and a way to review saved content using LLMs and spaced repetition. It is currently in beta but usable.
mentions.problem: Pocket shut down and lacked a search-first experience, integrations with existing tools like Telegram, and a way to actually review saved content.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been building https://getpensive.com a bookmarking app I started after Pocket shut down.

evidence.value: I’ve been building https://getpensive.com a bookmarking app I started after Pocket shut down.
